texts.title: A Child With Nowhere To Go
texts.body: {child.name} of {child.house} is the kind of child houses talk about in lowered voices: a family that cannot keep them, or will not, and no one stepping forward. A steward mentions it to {self.name} in passing, in the tone of someone mentioning the weather, and waits.

choices.take_the_child_in: Take the child into your house.
choices.find_them_a_place: Find them a place, and pay for it.

texts.title: The Ward Comes Of Age
texts.body: {ward.name} is sixteen, and free to go home to {ward.house}. {ward.name} has come to {self.name}'s study to say, a little stiffly, that they would rather stay, if there is a place for them here. They have clearly rehearsed it.

choices.you_are_family: "You are family. There was never a question."
choices.give_them_a_start: Settle a sum on them to begin with.
choices.say_little: Say it is sensible of them.

texts.title: The Accounts Do Not Add Up
texts.body: It is not much. A few credits a year, for some years, in a column that {steward.name} keeps and nobody else reads. {self.name} has read it now. {steward.name} was given the house's purse on trust, and has been treating a little of it as their own.

choices.make_them_repay_it: Make them repay it, and keep them.

texts.title: A Place At The Table
texts.body: There is a formal dinner, and a seating plan, and the steward has brought it to {self.name} with one name circled. {member.name} is of the household but not of the blood. Where {member.name} sits tonight will tell the whole house what {member.name} is.

choices.below_the_family: With the household, below the family.

texts.title: The Protégé Is Noticed
texts.body: People have begun to mention {protege.name} to {self.name} without being asked. A piece of work well done, a good answer in a hard room. They say it as a compliment to {self.name}, who brought {protege.name} on, and they watch to see how it is taken.

choices.say_so_in_public: Say in public how far they will go.

texts.title: The Wing Withdrawn
texts.body: For some years there was someone senior who answered {self.name}'s questions, spoke for {self.name} in rooms {self.name} was not in, and expected nothing but to be listened to. That is over now.
